svg.title: IPython Code Mode: run_code in a local IPython kernel
svg.desc: The model calls run_code with Python. The code runs in a separate IPython kernel process with full CPython and any installed package, such as pandas. Each call it makes to an agent tool, here get_sales, goes back to the agent over the Jupyter stdin channel and runs one at a time; the value of the last expression goes back to the model. Variables stay in the kernel for the next run_code call, each call has a 60 second timeout, and the kernel is not a sandbox: the code has the user's files, network and environment variables.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
